$comment: Where each template in env/ is pushed. Read by scripts/env/. Names only, no values.
$unmanaged: Names the code reads that are deliberately left out of the templates, with why.

unmanaged.ROSTER_SHEET_RANGE: optional, the admin defaults to A:ZZ

$optional: Names a push skips when their Proton Pass field is empty (the code works without them), with why.

optional.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_MAP_ID: the map falls back to the default style
optional.GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION: only needed to verify the site in Google Search Console
optional.BING_SITE_VERIFICATION: only needed to verify the site in Bing Webmaster Tools
optional.REVALIDATE_SECRET: without it admin edits wait for the cache to expire instead of refreshing the site

github.repo.$allowStagingItems: the e2e suite runs against staging

rules.$stagingSupabaseRef: the website-staging project (public, it is in the staging URL); env:seed checks values against it
